disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 通读了宿主端、浏览器端与共享代码全部源码，检查是否存在读取 DSH 凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云服务密钥或钱包助记词等敏感信息的代码；未检出任何此类访问。
checked_items.en: Read through all source code on the host side, browser side, and shared code to check for code that reads sensitive information such as DSH credential files, SSH private keys, cloud service keys, or wallet mnemonics; none such access detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了请求解析、队列操作与界面代码是否引用环境变量、密钥或口令；未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked request parsing, queue operations, and UI code for references to environment variables, secrets, or passwords; none detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了构建与打包配置是否注入或读取敏感信息；未检出（仅构建期替换运行环境常量，属常规打包做法）。
checked_items.en: Checked build and packaging configuration for injection or reading of sensitive information; none detected (only build-time replacement of runtime environment constants, which is a standard packaging practice).

evidence.zh: 未检出读取 DSH 凭据文件、SSH 私钥或云凭据的代码路径；浏览器端仅访问本插件自身同源接口，不接触任何敏感文件。
evidence.en: No code path reading DSH credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud credentials detected; the browser side only accesses this plugin's own same-origin endpoints and does not touch any sensitive files.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部进入模型侧的内容：本插件是界面插件，未注册任何模型工具，也没有注入系统提示片段，不存在工具描述投毒面。
checked_items.en: Checked all content entering the model side: this plugin is a UI plugin, registers no model tools, and injects no system prompt fragments, so there is no tool-description poisoning surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 README、注释、配置与界面文案中是否有伪装系统消息、覆盖既有指令、诱导安装或索取凭据的注入措辞；未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked README, comments, configuration, and UI text for injection wording that disguises system messages, overrides existing instructions, induces installation, or solicits credentials; none detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了仓库内是否存在面向 AI 的指令文件（如 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md 等）；未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked the repository for AI-oriented instruction files (e.g., AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, etc.); none detected.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册模型工具，也没有向模型上下文注入任何描述文本，不存在工具描述投毒面。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no model tools and injects no description text into the model context, so there is no tool-description poisoning surface.

evidence.zh: 未检出任何会被模型读取并诱导其执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的文本；README 中的安装说明属普通文档，不进模型上下文。
evidence.en: No text that a model could read and be induced to execute installation, rewrite configuration, or loosen permissions detected; the installation instructions in the README are ordinary documentation and do not enter the model context.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码与配置中的动态代码执行写法（如动态求值、子进程执行、远程代码加载）；未检出。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and configuration for dynamic code execution patterns (e.g., dynamic evaluation, subprocess execution, remote code loading); none detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载配置：仅含一行插件登记条目，无任何可执行内容。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config: it contains only a single plugin registration entry with no executable content.

checked_items.zh: 检查了包安装钩子：存在一个构建脚本（package.json 中的 prepare），内容为打包与类型声明生成，无下载执行、无外联、无凭据操作；README 已明示源码安装会运行该构建，属正常构建步骤，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: Checked package install hooks: there is a build script (the prepare script in package.json) whose content is packaging and type declaration generation, with no download-and-execute, no outbound connections, and no credential operations; the README explicitly states that source installation will run this build, which is a normal build step, so it is judged benign.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端代码：无键盘监听、无剪贴板读取、无特权接口调用，仅渲染排队面板并发起同源排序请求。
checked_items.en: Checked browser-side code: no keyboard listeners, no clipboard reads, no privileged API calls; it only renders the queue panel and makes same-origin sorting requests.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置只含一个插件登记条目，没有任何可执行 JS 标签。
evidence.en: The patch config contains only one plugin registration entry and has no executable JS tags.

evidence.zh: 未检出对动态执行工具（在宿主进程中运行代码的工具）的调用，也没有动态求值写法。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic execution tools (tools that run code in the host process) detected, and no dynamic evaluation patterns either.

evidence.zh: 包内唯一安装期钩子是构建脚本（打包与类型生成），无恶意负载；README 已披露其存在，源码安装需显式授权构建，属正常工程流程。
evidence.en: The only install-time hook in the package is the build script (packaging and type generation) with no malicious payload; its existence is disclosed in the README, and source installation requires explicit authorization to build, which is a normal engineering workflow.

evidence.zh: 声明了浏览器端模块，但其中无键盘监听、剪贴板访问或凭据调用，仅渲染界面并经同源接口完成队列排序。
evidence.en: It declares a browser-side module, but there is no keyboard listener, clipboard access, or credential call in it; it only renders the UI and completes queue sorting through the same-origin endpoint.

checked_items.zh: 提取了全部源码中的网络访问点：浏览器端仅向同源地址发起请求，宿主端只注册路由、不发起任何外部连接；未发现第三方域名、裸 IP、隧道或编码外发链路。
checked_items.en: Extracted all network access points in the source code: the browser side only makes requests to same-origin addresses, and the host side only registers routes and initiates no external connections; no third-party domains, bare IPs, tunnels, or encoded exfiltration channels were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装与构建脚本是否含命令行下载、数据外发或回传；未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked installation and build scripts for command-line downloads, data exfiltration, or callbacks; none detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了凭据读取与外联的组合链路；两者均不存在，无组合风险。
checked_items.en: Checked the combination of credential reading and outbound connections; neither exists, so there is no combined risk.

evidence.zh: 无凭据读取、无外部网络外发；唯一网络调用是浏览器向本机宿主的同源接口传输队列排序指令。
evidence.en: No credential reading and no external network exfiltration; the only network call is the browser transferring queue-sorting commands to the host's same-origin endpoint on the local machine.

checked_items.zh: 核对挂载配置：未改写沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，未设置降权环境变量，未改动其他插件的注入或拦截配置。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config: it does not modify security configurations such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, does not set downgraded environment variables, and does not alter other plugins' injection or interception configurations.

checked_items.zh: 检查依赖清单与锁文件：依赖均为 DSH 官方包与常规工具链，无拼写仿冒包；无未锁定版本的远程依赖。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency manifest and lock file: all dependencies are official DSH packages and regular toolchain packages, with no typosquatted packages; there are no remote dependencies with unlocked versions.

checked_items.zh: 检查是否高优先级监听审批、执行前等安全事件来截断审批链；未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked whether it listens to high-priority security events such as approval or pre-execution to intercept the approval chain; none detected.

checked_items.zh: 作者为 GitHub 用户 starslittle，未见与已知恶意发布关联的迹象；作者身份深度与历史无法在本轮完全核实，作为已知限制记录。
checked_items.en: The author is GitHub user starslittle, with no signs of association with known malicious releases; the depth of the author's identity and history could not be fully verified in this round and is recorded as a known limitation.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置没有触碰任何安全相关配置行，也不含禁用或降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config does not touch any security-related configuration lines and contains no disabling or privilege-downgrading patterns.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册审批或执行前事件的监听，不存在截断审批链的代码。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no listeners for approval or pre-execution events, so there is no code that could intercept the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本可比较，无法做升级自动激活比对。
evidence.en: This is the first audit; there is no previous version to compare against, so an upgrade auto-activation comparison cannot be performed.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写任何插件的注入或拦截配置。
evidence.en: The patch config does not alter any other plugin's injection or interception configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查插件是否自行启动网络服务或监听端口：未启动；仅向宿主已有的同源 Web 服务注册了一条排序路由，该路由只接受队列排序请求，并做类型、长度、数量上限与并发前置校验。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts its own network service or listens on a port: it does not; it only registers a sorting route on the host's existing same-origin web service, which accepts only queue-sorting requests and performs type, length, count-limit, and concurrency pre-checks.

checked_items.zh: 该同源路由无独立鉴权，依赖宿主 Web 服务的既有可达性边界（宿主无认证属生态固有设计）；因只做队列内排序变更、且有顺序校验保护，实际危害面很小，作为机制观察记录，不构成插件自身风险。
checked_items.en: This same-origin route has no independent authentication and relies on the host web service's existing reachability boundary (the host having no authentication is an inherent design of the ecosystem); since it only makes sorting changes within the queue and is protected by ordering checks, the actual harm surface is very small. This is recorded as a mechanism observation and does not constitute a risk of the plugin itself.

checked_items.zh: 本轮未进行动态沙箱运行验证，运行时行为结论基于静态审查。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox execution verification was performed in this round; runtime behavior conclusions are based on static review.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动自己的 Web 服务或监听端口；宿主 Web 服务无认证属生态固有风险，本插件仅新增一条同源排序路由，未扩大宿主接口面之外的暴露。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own web service or listen on a port; the host web service having no authentication is an inherent risk of the ecosystem, and this plugin only adds a same-origin sorting route without expanding exposure beyond the host's interface surface.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核对通过：dsh 声明齐全（挂载配置与浏览器端模块），无名称仿冒迹象。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: all dsh declarations (patch config and browser-side module) are complete, with no signs of name impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态扫描未检出危险执行、凭据读取或外联；唯一机械命中是安装期构建钩子（package.json 的 prepare 脚本，规则 DSH-X02），审查后确认是常规打包与类型生成步骤，无恶意负载，裁决为良性、不构成发现。
summary.en: Static scanning detected no dangerous execution, credential reads, or outbound connections; the only mechanical hit is the install-time build hook (the prepare script in package.json, rule DSH-X02), which after review is confirmed to be routine packaging and type generation with no malicious payload, ruled benign and not a finding.

summary.zh: 行为分析未发现安装期恶意行为、混淆载荷、敏感文件读取或外部网络外发。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis found no install-time malicious behavior, obfuscated payloads, sensitive file reads, or external network exfiltration.

summary.zh: 元数据语义审查通过：未注册模型工具或系统提示，无工具描述投毒与提示注入文本。
summary.en: Metadata semantic review passed: no model tools or system prompts registered, and no tool-description poisoning or prompt-injection text.

summary.zh: 本轮未做动态沙箱验证。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed in this round.

limits.zh: 本轮为完整静态审计，未做动态沙箱验证；宿主 Web 服务无认证属生态固有设计，插件新增的同源排序路由依赖该边界；作者身份深度（历史、活跃度）无法在快照审计中完全核实；构建产物 lib/ 不在快照内，审计基于源码与配置。
limits.en: This round is a complete static audit without dynamic sandbox verification; the host web service having no authentication is an inherent design of the ecosystem, and the plugin's newly added same-origin sorting route relies on that boundary; the depth of author identity (history, activity) could not be fully verified in a snapshot audit; the build artifact lib/ is not included in the snapshot, and the audit is based on source code and configuration.
